projects.title: SecureRAG
projects.tagline: 5-LAYER ZERO-TRUST MULTI-AGENT DEFENSE FOR ENTERPRISE RAG
projects.summary: Mathematically grounded 5-Layer Zero-Trust Multi-Agent Defense Pipeline halting Indirect Prompt Injection, PoisonedRAG, and Namespace Traversal.
projects.architecture_md:
## 5-Layer Zero-Trust RAG Architecture
1. **Input Firewall (Layer 1):** Pre-retrieval threat filter sanitizing inputs in ~5ms.
2. **RBAC-Gated Hybrid Retrieval (Layer 2):** Dense BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 + sparse BM25 retrieval with tenant isolation.
3. **Context Sanitizer & Consensus (Layer 3):** Cross-chunk consensus filtering neutralizing PoisonedRAG chunks.
4. **128-Bit Cryptographic Hex Nonce Spotlight (Layer 4):** Synthesizer isolation preventing indirect prompt injection breakouts.
5. **Post-Generation Output & Citation Auditor (Layer 5):** Automated claim-to-source chunk validator blocking PII and hallucinations.

ai_explainer.problem_statement: Enterprise RAG deployments remain vulnerable to indirect prompt injection, cross-tenant namespace traversal, and poisoned context injection attacks that bypass standard LLM system prompts.
architecture_stack: Qdrant Hybrid Vector + BM25 Lexical Store
engineering_highlights: Reduced prompt-injection attack success rate from 100% to 0% across a 6-scenario adversarial red-team suite.
Engineered 128-bit cryptographic hex nonces that isolate untrusted retrieved text into passive, non-executable data.
Enforced automated post-generation citation auditing verifying every synthesized sentence against source chunks.

security_highlights: Attack success rate dropped from 100% to 0.0%
128-bit per-turn cryptographic hex nonce delimiters

projects.title: Computer Vision — Denoising Prior to Edge Detection
projects.tagline: SPATIAL DENOISING PRIORS, CANNY EDGE RECOVERY & 3D INTENSITY TOPOGRAPHY
projects.summary: Interactive computer vision laboratory benchmarking how Gaussian, Median, and Bilateral denoising priors recover Canny edge topology and SSIM fidelity under severe sensor noise.
projects.architecture_md:
## Computer Vision Signal Analysis Pipeline
1. **Noise Injection:** Generates controlled Gaussian and Salt & Pepper noise distributions.
2. **Spatial Prior Filtering:** Computes spatial responses across Gaussian blur, Median filtering, and Bilateral edge-preserving smoothing.
3. **Sobel Gradient & Non-Maximum Suppression:** Computes gradient magnitude/orientation and thins ridges into 1-pixel edge candidates.
4. **Quantitative Evaluation:** Evaluates Structural Similarity Index (SSIM) and Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) against ground truth.
5. **3D Intensity Topography:** Projects 2D grayscale intensity into interactive 3D heightfields showing noise spikes vs. smoothed edge cliffs.

ai_explainer.problem_statement: Camera sensor noise (Gaussian and Salt-and-Pepper) corrupts pixel intensity gradients, causing standard Canny edge detectors to shatter real object boundaries or trigger false noise edges.
engineering_highlights: Quantified denoising trade-offs using SSIM metrics alongside visual edge fidelity maps.
Visualized image gradient intensity as interactive 3D topographical surfaces.
Empirically demonstrated bilateral filter superiority in preserving sharp object boundaries under heavy sensor noise.

security_highlights: Deterministic image processing algorithms with zero cloud dependencies
Bounded image dimension constraints preventing memory exhaustion

model_3d_config.core_concept: Benchmarks Gaussian, Median, and Bilateral smoothing priors in Google Colab before running Canny edge detection—proving via 3D pixel-intensity surfaces and SSIM/PSNR metrics that edge-preserving bilateral filtering recovers 94% structural fidelity.

projects.tagline: AUTOMATED DATA CLEANING, OUTLIER SCRUBBING & STATISTICAL VISUALIZATION

projects.architecture_md:
## Google Colab 4-Stage Data Wrangling Pipeline
1. **Raw Ingestion & Schema Audit:** Validates missing rows, parses column types, and checks null distributions.
2. **Domain-Aware Null Imputation:** Applies median/mode imputation while purging high-sparsity features (>40% nulls).
3. **IQR & Z-Score Outlier Scrubbing:** Removes 3-sigma distortions to preserve statistical distribution fidelity.
4. **Multivariate Correlation & EDA:** Generates Spearman heatmaps and distribution plots with publication clarity.

ai_explainer.problem_statement: Real-world datasets arrive with missing fields, duplicate records, and extreme outliers that distort statistical averages and break downstream analytics.
engineering_highlights: Automated cleaning pipeline handling arbitrary tabular datasets with domain-aware imputation.
Purged 127 extreme outliers via IQR fences, boosting statistical correlation stability from R² 0.61 to 0.89.
Exported publication-grade multivariate distribution graphs and correlation matrices.

security_highlights: Isolated Python memory scope avoiding dataset memory leaks
Strict datatype validation blocking malformed input rows
